assumptions: The ready V2X-06 Living surface frame preserves its upstream model authority and bounded projection.
limitations: Terrain height, material color, coastline and river geometry are presentation encodings, not measured elevation, canonical geodesy or empirical paths.

fidelity.validity: Bounded V2X-06 surface cells and paths become camera-relative mesh and curve packets.
fidelity.resolution: Existing adaptive V2X-06 patch budget with deterministic terrain and path packet bounds.
fidelity.uncertainty: Inherited model and presentation limitations remain explicit; raster pixels are device-dependent.

assumptions: V2X-07 supplies bounded local terrain, embodiment identities and upstream authority metadata.
limitations: Local positions and extents remain model/presentation encodings and are not canonical metric geodesy.

fidelity.validity: Bounded V2X-07 terrain and embodiments become camera-relative mesh packets.
fidelity.resolution: At most 2,304 terrain vertices and 768 bounded local objects.
fidelity.uncertainty: Inherited model and presentation uncertainty remains explicit; raster pixels are device-dependent.
